capabilities: Send statblock, map, prop and encounter blocks to a Tome server
Sync player-character notes to a campaign or a personal shelf
Compile a folder of notes into a self-contained PDF reference
Import feats and subclass features with uses from content-source notes
Write returned Tome IDs back into source blocks and frontmatter
extras: The folder-to-PDF feature is desktop only (mobile lacks Chromium's PDF engine); all other features work on mobile. Server image-size caps apply when downscaling is off, and an oversized statblock cover art silently drops its picture. Adventure folder import format is documented in docs/authoring-adventures.md, not in the README.
problem: TTRPG content written in Obsidian has no built-in way to move statblocks, maps, characters or whole note folders into a campaign tool like Tome.

relations.evidence: Tome Connector is an Obsidian plugin that sends selected note content to a Tome server.
